data.name: DOS001_What
data.value: {0} requires CS to be the program segment (PSP {1:X4}h), but CS is {2:X4}h
data.comment: {0} = the service, such as INT 20h; {1} = PSP segment; {2} = CS

data.name: DOS001_Next
data.value: Use INT 21h AH=4Ch (exit code in AL), which works from any code segment, or call this service with CS = PSP.

data.name: DOS002_What
data.value: INT 21h AH=09h found no '$' terminator in the 64 KiB segment starting at {0:X4}:{1:X4}

data.name: DOS002_Next
data.value: End the string with '$' (for example: msg db 'Hello', 13, 10, '$') and check that DS:DX points to it.
